What I do

Scoring

Original music for features, shorts, series and games. Themes that carry the story and leave room for the picture to breathe.

Mixing

Warm, clear, powerful mixes. Stems, stereo and immersive formats, prepared to sit properly against dialogue and effects.

Post-production

Dialogue editing, sound design and final mix in one place, so the whole soundtrack feels like one world.

Collaboration

Close work with directors and editors from spotting to delivery. Clear notes, fast turnarounds, no surprises.

A few minutes of favourite scenes, scored, mixed and finished.
